text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 193 May 15, 1973
TRANSFERRING THE CNI SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM INCLUDING THE FUNDS AND PROPERTY
THEREOF TO THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION AND CULTURE
WHEREAS, the Government recognizes the importance of the integration and consolidation of its scholarship
programs as envisioned in Republic Act No. 4090;
WHEREAS, the State deems it its duty to grant educational opportunities to deserving members of the
Cultural Minorities through proper and systematic selection of grantees, and the proper channeling of said
grantees to appropriate courses in line with their aptitudes and abilities geared to the manpower needs of the
New Society;
WHEREAS, as early as November 1972 the CNI Commissioner made representations with the Department of
Education to administer the test for CNI scholars; and
WHEREAS, the Department of Education and Culture has an adequate and competent staff which can handle
the testing program;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1 dated September 22,
1972, do hereby order and decree that the CNI Scholarship Program including the funds and property thereof
be transferred to the Department of Education and Culture. The Secretary of Education and Culture shall
designate and appropriate office or unit under the Department to administer the program.
This decree shall form part of the law of the land and shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
